You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models a very small single-variable transition system over the natural numbers. The state variable x starts at 0, increments by 1 while it is less than 3, and then stutters forever once it reaches 3 or more. The temporal property Spec requires that the initial condition holds and that every step is either a Next step or a stuttering step on x, expressed with the standard boxed action formula.

Your module MUST define these names so the configuration binds: Limit, Spec
